#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is caused by the password reset email link using a BASE_URL set from the environment variable PUBLIC_URL, which defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not defined. This results in the reset-password email link pointing to localhost when the environment variable is missing or not set correctly in the deployment environment.
